Interface ConnectionSupplier

All Superinterfaces:
Supplier<Connection>
public interface ConnectionSupplier extends Supplier<Connection>
Minimalist interface which provides a Connection.
This implementation can also provide information about connection state.

    • valueOf

      @NotNull static @NotNull ConnectionSupplier valueOf(@NotNull @NotNull String url, @Nullable @Nullable String user, @Nullable @Nullable String password) throws SQLException
      Create a connection supplier using the provided connection parameters.
      Parameters:
      url - the database url.
      user - the database user on whose behalf the connection is being made.
      password - the user's password.
      Returns:
      a newly generated connection supplier containing the created connection.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.

    • valueOf

      Returns:
      a newly generated connection supplier containing the provided connection.
